entities.name: Prototype X-8
entities.description: Robot octopus of the Edge, an amalgam of organic and synthetic matter living on an icy moon.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: Body that issued a longstanding travel advisory about the moon Prototype X-8 inhabits.

events.summary: Explorers who ignore the Pinnacle travel advisory send glitched final transmissions.
events.quote: inevitably issue final transmissions that are too glitched and garbled to make out
